description_en: Extracts structured information such as size charts and package weight and dimensions from images by using multimodal large language models in asynchronous mode
description_zh: 通过多模态大模型智能提取图片中的尺码图、件重尺等结构化信息。（异步）
name: SizeChartExtractAsync

parameters.help_en: The image URL. The image must be in the JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format. The resolution must be between 256 × 256 pixels and 3000 × 3000 pixels, and the file size cannot exceed 10 MB
parameters.help_zh: 图片 URL，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至3000x3000像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The list of column names to extract, such as Size, Bust, and Length
parameters.help_zh: 需要提取的列名列表，如 Size、Bust、Length
parameters.name: column_name_list

parameters.help_en: The output language format. If you do not specify this parameter, the original language is used. If the original image language is Chinese or English, specifying en outputs English, and specifying cn outputs Chinese
parameters.help_zh: 输出语言格式，不填默认原版语言输出。若原图片语言为中文或者英文，输入en将输出英文，填cn将输出中文
parameters.name: language_model

parameters.help_en: The business order number of the caller. It is recorded when the request is accepted and returned as is when you query the asynchronous task result
parameters.help_zh: 调用方业务单号，受理时记录并在查询异步任务结果时原样返回
parameters.name: biz_id

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is not returned for normal calls
Code.description_zh: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The commit result of the size chart fetch asynchronous task node
Data.description_zh: 尺码图提取异步任务提交结果

TaskId.description_en: The task ID used to query the asynchronous task result
TaskId.description_zh: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID
TaskId.title_en: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID
TaskId.title_zh: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID

Data.title_en: 尺码图提取异步任务提交结果
Data.title_zh: 尺码图提取异步任务提交结果

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned for normal calls

Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to identify a unique request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID：用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_zh: 是否成功：true代表成功，false代表失败
